1. Confirm the new venue and time before you start writing.
2. Keep the tone formal but not stiff.
3. Open with an apology and explain why it moved.
4. List the new agenda and mark the coffee break.
5. Update the launch on the shared calendar and notify registered press and guests.
6. Send me the draft to approve before it goes out.
7. Subject line: "Launch event rescheduled". Five paragraphs at most.
8. In the new agenda, give each session an owner and a length.
9. Add the new venue's address, parking and arrival time.
10. If Mr. Wang joins remotely, have a video call link ready.
11. Don't leave Mr. Zhang from Finance off the CC list.
12. All attachments as PDF, with the date in the file name.
Also:
